assets.name: inkling
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original full-body 2D enemy portrait for Triseal, a maritime fantasy card combat game, to composite over a battle environment.
Input image: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match the tactile painterly materials, sophisticated shading, weathering, and cinematic detail of the reference card art. Do not copy the needle, card composition, or observatory scenery.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background. A single isolated creature only. No environment, floor, shadow plane, rectangular glow, framing, text, UI, border, or watermark.
Style/medium: high quality hand-painted fantasy game illustration, dimensional but painterly, not a flat icon, emoji, cartoon or photograph. Bold readable silhouette that remains clear when displayed small.
Composition/framing: entire body centered and occupying approximately 80% of square image; all appendages fully inside the frame, with transparent breathing room. Three-quarter LEFT-facing view, clearly looking left toward its opponent. Clean cutout edges. Soft glow restricted to within the body, no outside rectangular haze.
Subject: Inkling, a mysterious small sea-octopus spirit. Its amethyst mantle forms a dripping ink hood, with four to six elegantly curling thick tentacles. Ancient indigo lacquer surface with subtle marine texture; translucent lavender along the edges. Two narrowed luminous lilac eyes on the LEFT-facing side. A few tiny ink droplets very close to the body. A magical creature with sly, ancient personality. Shape is solid and clearly readable, rich purple shadows and subtle cool edge lighting. No props.
